 Santiago & Romero Law Group
 Baytown, TX
 Phone 832-555-2357
 Settlement Demand
09/11/2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1404 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Joshua Lee in connection with a collision that occurred on 05/17/2023. Our client was driving in the right
lane when your insured, who was changing lanes from the left, moved into the space our client occupied and sideswiped the
passenger side of the vehicle. The contact was forceful enough to push our client's car toward the shoulder and to leave visible
damage along the entire side panel. Police were called to the scene, and the report reflects that your insured acknowledged failing
to check the blind spot before merging.
Following the impact, our client experienced immediate neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. Medical evaluation
diagnosed a cervical strain, and our client has since completed a course of physical therapy and continues to experience
headaches and limited mobility that interfere with work and daily routines. Records documenting treatment, time missed from
work, and out-of-pocket expenses are enclosed.
Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured's failure to yield during a lane change caused the collision, and no comparative fault
can fairly be assigned to our client. We therefore request that your company resolve this claim by paying the sum of $138,000.00
within thirty days of the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response by that deadline, we are prepared to file
suit to recover full compensation for our client's damages.
Expert review: Melanie Munoz, orthopedic surgeon
Sincerely,
Eric Phillips
Santiago & Romero Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
